notes:
New Features:

- Long-duration checks now bind their runtime state to the current Kodi process session, allowing stale state from an earlier Kodi run to be detected and removed automatically.
- Every long-check hold step now has a unique step ID and an independent watchdog in addition to Kodi AlarmClock, preventing missed end actions while still suppressing duplicate timer execution.

Improvements:

- A stale IPTV Auto Check anchor is automatically cleared and re-scheduled instead of silently blocking a new One Channel or group check.
- Dorcel TV now enables InputStream Adaptive HLS repair options for inconsistent media and discontinuity sequence values.
- Dorcel diagnostics now log media sequence, discontinuity sequence, EXT-X-DISCONTINUITY markers and PROGRAM-DATE-TIME data for more precise analysis of the recurring freeze pattern.

Bugfixes:

- Fixes stale adulttvtest_2h_check runtime data surviving a Kodi restart and preventing a newly configured 1 h/2 h check from being armed.
- Fixes the case where Shutdown + Copy Log could never execute because the long-check timer had not actually been started.
- Prevents AlarmClock and the fallback watchdog from executing the same completed hold step twice.
